summary: Excel Links now changes a workbook link from a row's right-click menu and refreshes everything on ArcRho Server.
details: The Change button, header text, and recalculation checkbox are gone: right-click a workbook and choose Change Link.

Changing a link always re-reads the new workbook on ArcRho Server, re-saves every affected dataset and DFM method, and marks them and their dependents Needs Review even when the numbers did not change.
Found/Missing now reports whether ArcRho Server can open the workbook, and a workbook the server cannot open is refused with the reason instead of being linked.
